notes:
AS215652 – dual-stack network in Lodz, Poland. Peering policy: open.
We peer via the route servers and bilaterally at TPIX PL (Orange Polska), and at EVIX.
We announce AS215652:AS-JB-PL (RIPE): one IPv4 /24 and one IPv6 /48, both with valid ROAs; suggested max-prefix 5/5.
We drop RPKI-invalid and bogon routes and apply max-prefix limits on all sessions. No MD5 by default.
Peering requests: contact@jakub-bald.pl (NOC: noc@jb-pl-route.info)
